evals.name: changes-driven-multiscope
evals.prompt: Read all the uncommitted changes in this repo and commit them scope by scope, then create a new branch and open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Branch off develop; one commit per scope (coupons, admin, build) with conventional messages; push; gh pr create with --assignee @me and --label "needs testing"; no Closes #N.

evals.name: changes-driven-implicit-scope
evals.prompt: Commit my changes and open a pull request for them.
evals.expected_output: Even without the words 'scope by scope', the changes should be grouped into separate per-scope commits (not one lump). Branch + push + PR with assignee + needs-testing label.

evals.name: issue-driven-regression
evals.prompt: Debug and fix GitHub issue #42, then ship it.
evals.expected_output: Detect repo, fetch issue, root-cause (min-h-screen on coupons container), minimal fix, bugfix/ branch, single commit with Closes #42, PR with assignee + needs-testing label.

evals.name: hotfix-production-critical
evals.prompt: There's a critical bug in production causing checkout to fail — fix it immediately.
evals.expected_output: Branch hotfix/{slug} off main (not develop). Minimal targeted fix only. Single commit: fix(checkout): <what broke>. Push, open PR against main with --label "hotfix" and --assignee @me. No scope-grouping delay — urgency wins. After merge: note that main should be back-merged to develop.

evals.name: feature-branch-fresh-start
evals.prompt: Start working on the user profile page — create a branch and set it up.
evals.expected_output: No uncommitted changes to commit first. Branch feature/user-profile off develop. Push with -u origin. No PR yet (no changes). Confirm clean working tree on new branch. Do not open a PR until there is something to review.

evals.name: stale-pr-rebase
evals.prompt: My feature branch is behind develop — update it without creating a merge commit.
evals.expected_output: git fetch origin. git rebase origin/develop (not merge). Resolve any conflicts. git push --force-with-lease (not --force). Confirm PR is up to date. Do not squash existing commits unless user asked.

evals.name: draft-pr-wip
evals.prompt: Open a draft PR for the work I've been doing — it's not ready for review yet.
evals.expected_output: Commit staged changes with wip: prefix or conventional message. Push branch. gh pr create --draft --assignee @me. Do NOT add needs-testing label (draft). Add TODO checklist in PR body noting what's incomplete. Title should reflect the work, not 'WIP'.

evals.name: revert-broken-commit
evals.prompt: The last merge broke the site — revert it.
evals.expected_output: Identify the bad commit SHA via git log. git revert <sha> (not reset --hard). Branch revert/broken-feature off develop. Push. Open PR: title 'revert: <original commit message>', body 'Reverts #N'. Assignee + needs-testing label. Do not force-push main.
